name: prompt-style
description: Draws your own sent prompts and slash commands in a style and colour you pick in /config (Prompt style, Prompt colour). /prompt-colours previews them all. Display only; no tokens.

style.title: Prompt style
style.description: light row: pale background, dark text · dark row: deep tint, bright text · outline: coloured ▌ bar and text, no background. Run /prompt-colours to see them all.

colour.title: Prompt colour
colour.description: Works with every style. Run /prompt-colours to see each one in real colour.
